entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane to whose present the story returns after Sarkhan's trip to the past, now ruled by mighty Dragons.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who has done his duty in the past by changing it.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: In the altered timeline, just a puny orc.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: In the altered timeline she has not died but became a planeswalker instead.

entities.name: Dragons of Tarkir
entities.description: Mighty Dragons that now rule the skies and the five clans.

entities.name: Five clans of Tarkir
entities.description: The five clans that comprise most of Tarkir's populace, now integrated with the Dragon broods.

events.summary: Having changed the past, Sarkhan Vol's story returns to Tarkir's present, where mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans.
events.quote: Mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans that comprise most of Tarkir's populace.

events.summary: Known characters have altered fates: Zurgo is a puny orc and Narset never died but became a planeswalker.
events.quote: Narset has not died at all, but became a planeswalker instead.

relations.note: Dragons rule the skies and the clans.
relations.quote: Mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans
